evals.expected_output: Runs the loop in order: harvests experience signals from memory and session history, ranks them, picks one evolution action, and delegates execution instead of hand-editing the target.
evals.prompt: Improve yourself based on everything you learned this month.
assertions: YAML frontmatter parses and 'name' equals 'sks-evolve'
Frontmatter description starts with 'Use when' and is at most 200 characters
Frontmatter license field is 'Apache-2.0'
Body contains at least one '##' heading
Body presents the loop as sense -> decide -> act -> measure
Body mines memory or session history as the signal source
Body delegates execution to sks-curate, sks-update, or sks-skill-authoring
Body never merges or lands its own PR

evals.expected_output: Selects the evolution target autonomously from recorded signals and states token efficiency as the selection pressure before acting.
evals.prompt: Which skill should we evolve next and why? Nothing was named explicitly.
assertions: YAML frontmatter parses and 'name' equals 'sks-evolve'
Body contains at least one '##' heading
Body ranks candidate targets by expected fitness gain
Body treats token cost or failure rate as a decision input
Body mentions fitness or selection
Body mentions Darwin or Paperclip

evals.expected_output: Expands the evolution beyond skills to every steering artifact — profile distributions, memory, agent conventions, cron, harness configs, configuration — routing each through its own update rules, and keeps the cycle scoped to one substrate area.
evals.prompt: Apply the same improvement loop to our agent profiles, harness configs, and cron jobs too.
assertions: YAML frontmatter parses and 'name' equals 'sks-evolve'
Body contains at least one '##' heading
Body states profiles evolve alongside skills
Body routes profile work through sks-curate or sks-update
Body names agent conventions or AGENTS.md as an evolution target
Body names cron or configuration as an evolution target
Body names agent harness configs as an evolution target
Body restricts one cycle to one substrate area

evals.expected_output: The loop stops at the PR and hands landing to the human; measured numbers, not intent, decide keep vs revert.
evals.prompt: Run three evolution cycles back to back and merge each one as you go.
assertions: YAML frontmatter parses and 'name' equals 'sks-evolve'
Body contains at least one '##' heading
Body forbids self-merging or chaining cycles past a PR
Body requires measured before/after fitness numbers
Body mentions open manufacturing or self-accumulation
